headword: {一級建築士|いっきゅうけんちくし}
reading: いっきゅうけんちくし

definitions.explanation: The highest level of architect certification in Japan, issued by the national government. Holders are qualified to design buildings of any size, including large commercial, industrial, and public structures.

examples.japanese: 彼女⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{一級建築士|いっきゅうけんちくし}だ。
examples.english: She is a first-class licensed architect.

examples.japanese: {一級建築士|いっきゅうけんちくし}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{試験|しけん}→試験：01422_shiken⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{難関|なんかん}→難関：16164_nankan⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{知|し}られている→知る：00458_shiru⟧。
examples.english: The first-class architect exam is known to be difficult.

examples.japanese: ⟦その→その：00993_sono⟧{設計事務所|せっけいじむしょ}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、すべて⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦スタッフ→スタッフ：11046_sutaffu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{一級建築士|いっきゅうけんちくし}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{資格|しかく}→資格：02834_shikaku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{持|も}っている→持つ：00478_motsu⟧。
examples.english: All the staff at that architectural firm hold first-class architect qualifications.

notes:
Japan's architect licensing system has two levels: 一級建築士 (first class, national license) and ⟦{二級建築士|にきゅうけんちくし}→二級建築士：29182_nikyuukenchikushi⟧ (second class, prefectural license). Only 一級建築士 can design large-scale buildings.

- {一級建築士|いっきゅうけんちくし}{事務所|じむしょ}: first-class architect firm
- {一級建築士|いっきゅうけんちくし}⟦{免許|めんきょ}→免許：03808_menkyo⟧: first-class architect license
